data.name: Hasninaht
data.gender_notes: Hasninaht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The one who is gentle, loving and kind
data.long_meaning: Hasninaht is a beautiful and gentle name for a girl, derived from the Arabic word 'hasanah' which means 'goodness' and 'kindness'. This name signifies a gentle and loving soul, and is a reminder to be kind and compassionate towards others. The name Hasninaht carries the meaning “The one who is gentle, loving and kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Hasninaht usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who is gentle, loving and kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hasninaht is a spiritual name that represents the gentle and loving nature of Allah (SWT). It is a reminder to strive for inner peace, kindness and compassion towards all beings, and to spread love and light in the world.
data.etymology: Hasninaht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The one who is gentle, loving and kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hasninaht total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
